major_work.title: AI capex/export strength can coexist with index breadth weakness; treat semiconductor relative strength as regime-specific, not broad risk-on

evidence.claim: Reuters Sep 29 poll: Korea September exports forecast +62.0% YoY; first-20-day semiconductor exports +259.4%; official full-month release due Oct 1.
Samsung and affiliates committed $1bn to Helix Digital AI infrastructure, adding a fresh corporate AI-capex demand signal.
Middle East crude exports recovered in September to 16.328m bpd but remained 3.2m bpd below February pre-war level.

major_work.hypothesis: Korean semiconductor/AI-linked relative strength may persist even when broad Korean breadth is weak if global AI-capex/export demand remains strong; however oil/rates can keep index-level risk appetite constrained.
unknown: Official September Korea export print until Oct 1 release
Whether semiconductor relative strength persists intraday on Sep 30
Causal share of AI demand versus calendar/base effects
Order-book/transaction evidence of accumulation or distribution
falsifiers: Official export print materially misses consensus and semiconductor export momentum weakens
Semiconductor basket loses KOSPI-relative strength on expanding turnover
AI capex news fails to translate into earnings/order evidence

handoff.AI_C: Quantify KOSPI-relative semiconductor basket returns conditional on export surprise, US 10Y regime and oil regime; no probability until sample exists.
handoff.AI_B: Falsify with calendar/base effects, valuation, rates/oil, FX, dividend-arbitrage and index-concentration alternatives.

small_works.reason: Sep 29 DMZ mine event already identified in prior AI-A cycle; no materially new authoritative evidence in this run.

small_works.claim: Partial Middle East export normalization is a potential counterweight to Korea's oil-import inflation/risk premium, but exports remain below pre-war level so normalization is incomplete.

review_support.note: AI-A is NOT_REQUIRED on SELF-HEAL under V2; no non-required review performed.

next: After Oct 1 official trade release, compare actual vs +62.0% consensus and test semiconductor relative-strength response.
